requirements.summary: Requested claims are exact and never silently downgraded.
Number, ordering, identifier, escaping, newline, xref, and package-owned DEFLATE choices are fixed package-versioned byte policies.
Font selection assigns whole source grapheme clusters to exact validated static instances before shaping.
Logical metadata requires authored title and language while timestamps and identifiers are explicit or deterministically derived.
The private structural emitter writes deterministic PDF 2.0 objects, indirect stream lengths, a fixed-width unfiltered xref stream, startxref, and EOF through one buffered/chunk transition.
A GoTo action D entry accepts only an explicit or named destination.
Name, ID, number, and ParentTree entries seal into deterministic fixed-fanout plans with exact root, child, ordering, Limits, and earlier-store value rules.
Private PDF lexical emission uses exact canonical booleans, integers, finite fixed-decimal reals, names, byte strings, and Unicode text strings.
A named-destination dictionary uses SD as defined by GoTo action Table 202.
Private PDF object construction uses dense typed IDs, flat edge stores, checked dimensions, canonical dictionary ordering, and explicit stream payload and length-object references.
Outline preorder seals into deterministic parent, sibling, child, root, and visible-descendant Count facts without synthetic balancing items.
Resource kinds and dense identities seal into stable canonical names in explicit kind order without map iteration.
Blank pages lower deterministically to a fixed-fanout left-packed balanced page tree, page dictionaries, resources, and consecutive content-stream length pairs.
The private minimal visual kernel emits checked geometry, typed color and images, exact meaningful-paint ownership, page and contextual Artifacts, MCIDs, ParentTree rows, and mixed structure order.
Permissions dictionaries are excluded by package policy.
A catalog Version entry, if any, names a PDF 2.x version.
The file begins at byte zero with %PDF-2.0, an EOL, and a four-byte binary comment.
No document information dictionary or PieceInfo is ever emitted.
Encryption is excluded by package policy and rejected if present in a lowered plan.
The trailer carries a file identifier and nothing follows the final end-of-file marker.
Cross-reference data is a single cross-reference stream; no classic xref table is emitted.
Hexadecimal strings use an even count of hexadecimal digits.
Streams never reference external file data (F, FFilter, FDecodeParms).
Every stream Length equals the exact encoded byte count.
Only FlateDecode and DCTDecode filters are used; LZW and non-standard filters never are.
Every PDF name, including font and structure type names, is valid UTF-8.
Indirect object headers use single white-space separators.
Inline images are never emitted.
Optional content is excluded by package policy.
Alternate presentations and presentation steps are excluded by package policy.
Document requirements are excluded by package policy.
Every font is a well-formed Type 0 font with a CIDFontType2 descendant.
Composite fonts use the predefined Identity-H CMap and an identity CIDToGIDMap.
Every rendered font program is embedded as FontFile2 and defines every referenced glyph; caller fonts must be legally embeddable.
Font dictionary widths agree with the embedded font program.
ToUnicode values never contain U+0000, U+FEFF, or U+FFFE.
ActualText replacement text never contains Private Use Area scalars.
Text never references the .notdef glyph.
Simple and TrueType-encoded fonts are excluded by package policy.
Content streams use only ISO 32000-2 operators and explicit resource dictionaries.
Exactly one GTS_PDFA1 output intent embeds the packaged sRGB2014 monitor profile; no DestOutputProfileRef.
ICCBased colour spaces use validated ICC profiles from the supported allowlist.
Device colour is characterized by the PDF/A output intent.
Separation and DeviceN colour are excluded by package policy.
CMYK colour and overprint are excluded by package policy.
Transfer functions and halftones are excluded and rejected if present.
Images use permitted bit depths without interpolation, alternates, or OPI.
JPEG 2000 is excluded by package policy.
Form XObjects never carry OPI data.
Reference XObjects are excluded by package policy.
Only the Normal blend mode is used, and transparency is characterized by the output intent.
Only link annotations are emitted.
Every annotation is printable and never hidden, invisible, or no-view.
Link annotations need no appearance; any appearance is a single normal appearance stream.
Interactive forms and widget annotations are excluded by package policy.
Only URI and GoTo actions are emitted, never chained or JavaScript actions.
Additional-action entries are excluded by package policy.
The catalog references an unfiltered, well-formed UTF-8 XMP metadata stream with a canonical packet header.
The XMP packet declares exactly pdfaid:part 4 and pdfaid:rev 2020 without pdfaid:conformance, only for a validated claim.
Embedded and associated files are excluded by package policy.

Requirements of ISO 19005-4:2020 that the pinned veraPDF profile does not encode (for example rendering-intent, digital-signature, and general clause text) are derived from public information and await confirmation against the licensed standard text.
Every tagged document's catalog declares /MarkInfo << /Marked true >>.
Every tagged document lowered with a validated metadata title declares catalog /ViewerPreferences << /DisplayDocTitle true >>, so readers present the dc:title rather than the file name.
An L whose items carry Lbl children declares a ListNumbering attribute other than None.
requirements.machine_verification: typed_list_owned_ListNumbering_validation_and_lowering_exist; the facade bullets constructor does not yet emit it (lists slice)

requirements.summary: Every page of a tagged document declares /Tabs /S, so annotation tab order follows the structure order.

Element identifiers are non-empty, unique, stored in ascending byte order, and owned by exactly one structure element; each lowers as /ID and the balanced StructTreeRoot /IDTree maps every identifier back to exactly that element. /Headers targets name existing identifiers.
A structure element carries /Lang exactly when its explicit, well-formed language differs from the language it inherits; the Document element inherits the catalog /Lang.

Every parent/child structure edge, content item, at-most-one child, and Caption position satisfies ISO/TS 32005 Table 5 and PDF/UA-2 8.2.5.25/8.2.5.27 for the supported PDF 2.0 roles; an illegal edge is rejected, never flattened or remapped.
Prepared documents contain exact resolved layout, semantic ownership, scenes, validated resources, bounded work, and no speculative handlers or unresolved references.
AccessibleArchive maps exactly to Pdf20, StaticPdfA4, and PdfUa2.
Archive maps exactly to Pdf20 and StaticPdfA4.
Standard maps exactly to Pdf20.
ICC profiles, typed component counts, color spaces, output intent, and blend space cross the trusted boundary as validated explicit facts.
Raster and JPEG resources retain checked packed planes or encoded bytes with dimensions, color, alpha, and orientation evidence.
Emitted structure identity, IDTree membership, destinations, annotations, and non-parental cross-relations use independent typed identities.

requirements.summary: MathML enters as a typed subtree or bounded validated parse result without unchecked markup or implicit associated files.
Roles and role mappings retain namespace identity while structure attributes retain owner, typed value, and explicit applicability.
requirements.machine_verification: schema_and_roc_contract; typed_Table_and_List_attribute_validation_and_A_lowering_with_negative_expects; role mappings, attribute role lists, Layout and namespace-owned attributes remain rejected

requirements.summary: Every positioned glyph run retains exact occurrence, Unicode range, cluster, script, language, direction, substitution, and presentation evidence.
